subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half shipped?
rationale: The remaining source-level bug is real, but the linked candidate PRs are stale, conflicting, or broader than this issue, and choosing adoption versus replacement is a maintainer ownership call.

options.title: Replace with a focused fix
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow replacement that persists routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct thread session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

options.title: Adopt one existing candidate
options.body: Pick a linked PR, rebase it, repair the known route/session risks, and use it as the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close remaining scope
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread recovery is no longer supported.

recommendation.title: Replace with a focused fix
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow replacement that persists routable non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct thread session entry and includes live cron/heartbeat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped message-tool fix and explicitly scoped it as partial for this issue, making them the best available owner for the follow-up path choice.
